import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(inp):
    H=len(inp);W=len(inp[0]); out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]==8]
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    rmin,rmax=min(rs),max(rs); cmin,cmax=min(cs),max(cs)
    h=max(rs)-rmin+1; w=max(cs)-cmin+1
    P=[[1 if inp[rmin+i][cmin+j] else 0 for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    n=sum(1 for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if inp[r][c]==4)
    o=P+[row[:] for row in P] if n==2 else P
    return o
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:

def load():

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(inp):
